name: blink-1hz
prompt: Build a circuit that blinks an LED once per second, running from a 9 V battery.
notes: The baseline. A 555 astable is the expected topology; local/blinker-1hz.json is a known-good answer at 0.99 Hz. Note RESET is compared to the timer's own VCC pin rather than to a net literally named VCC — an earlier version asserted `RESET == VCC` and failed a correct board whose supply rail was called V9. Net names are the designer's choice; only ground is fixed, at "0".
